Paired-end reads were generated with a length of 100 base pairs (PE100), and sequencing depth was optimized according to experimental requirements
data_processing: Alignment and quantification were accomplished with CellRanger (v. 7.1.0) using default options and reference genome GRCh38-2020-A.

Cells with mitochondria reads over 25% or fewer than 500 genes were removed.
All scRNA-seq samples were merged, and the cells were annotated by Azimuth (v.0.5.0) using the PBMC_ref_4546839 in Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/4546839).
